definition: to push air out of your mouth to move something
description: A young man puts his mouth close to a window furred with white frost and breathes hard on the glass until a clear round hole opens in it and his face shows through. He is then at a party with friends around him, leaning over a birthday cake covered in lit candles; he purses his lips, breathes out hard and the flames go out. Next he leans over a row of coloured paper party blowers on a white table and puffs them so they uncoil and shoot out one after another. Finally a long table crowded with dozens of candles and a room full of friends all lean in and puff together, then cheer with their arms up under the streamers and fairy lights.
